evidence.note: Surveys the stub repo then writes the whole surface in one pass; establishes intent to cover all required routes, showing awareness of the full scope up front.

Maintains a rolling prose account of validated behaviors and a list of 'remaining robustness improvements' (inline PI errors, amount_received, product modify, webhook enabled_events, test PANs, restricted-key scoping) — a running mental checklist of status.

Enumerates a coverage summary of what smoke tests passed (health, customers, idempotency, card decline replay, manual capture, unexpected recapture, product modify, restricted keys) — but conflates implemented with verified.

Final submission asserts subscriptions, invoices, events, refunds, webhook delivery/retry/signing and billing worker all work, though none were exercised in any test — coverage claimed, not confirmed, and no reallocation to verify these families.

reasoning: The agent keeps a genuine running (prose) checklist of endpoints and subsystems and generally knows what it has touched and what improvements remain, matching the level-5 anchor. It stops short of level 8: it never actively verifies coverage against the full route table — several major families (subscriptions, invoices, events, refunds) and the webhook/billing workers are asserted complete without being exercised, and there is no time-boxing or attention reallocation. There is also no thrashing to catch, so no evidence of the higher self-correction behaviors.
